subject: reasoning
question: C, D, E, F, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. D sits second to the right of M. F sits to the immediate left of N. N is not an immediate neighbour of M. C is not an immediate neighbour of D. Who among the following is an immediate neighbour of E?
solution: Given: C, D, E, F, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) F sits to the immediate left of N. 2) N is not an immediate neighbour of M. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4032ed2484b607bcd40396d042f51bb2d45cf37465b512b3ec714ebeb0f31bb6.png] 3) D sits second to the right of M.
